tickets.title: Restore secure online access to Velvet Acorn Custody portal
tickets.text: Restore secure online access to Lena Copperwisp’s Velvet Acorn Custody portal after repeated unexpected multifactor authentication prompts locked her out. Use a secure method that does not rely on the old SMS code path.
tickets.evidence: Lena reported receiving multiple unexpected multifactor authentication prompts overnight before being locked out of her Velvet Acorn Custody portal access.

tickets.title: Review unrecognized external bank nickname link
tickets.text: Review the pending external bank nickname shown in the Velvet Acorn Custody activity view that Lena Copperwisp did not recognize, and reconcile it with her known instructions and account records.
tickets.evidence: The custodian activity view shown during the call displayed a pending external bank nickname that Lena did not recognize, and no completed transfer from that pending destination was visible.

tickets.title: Update recurring transfer instructions to verified Teacup Comet Bank destination
tickets.text: Update the regular $2,500 monthly transfer from the joint taxable account to Teacup Comet Bank checking account to use only a verified Teacup Comet Bank destination with phone confirmation before money movement, as requested by Lena Copperwisp.
tickets.evidence: Lena asked for the regular taxable-account transfer to be paused until replacement instructions use only a verified Teacup Comet Bank destination with phone confirmation before money movement; the agreed follow-up is to update the instructions by April 14, 2025.

tickets.title: Collect Teacup Comet Bank incident documentation
tickets.text: Collect the Teacup Comet Bank incident reference, statement pages showing any attempted micro-deposits, and written confirmation of which bank account numbers remain valid.
tickets.evidence: the team did not yet have the Teacup Comet Bank incident reference, statement pages showing any attempted micro-deposits, or written confirmation of which bank account numbers remain valid; the agreed follow-up is to collect those materials by April 15, 2025.

tickets.title: Refresh custodian alert records and trusted contact verification
tickets.text: Refresh the Velvet Acorn Custody alert record to remove Lena’s prior work email and add Noah Copperwisp’s current mobile number as a trusted contact verification option.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review found the custodian alert record still used Lena’s prior work email and did not include Noah’s current mobile number as a trusted contact verification option; the agreed follow-up is to refresh those records by April 18, 2025.

tickets.title: Coordinate secure tuition funding for Marzipan Meadow School
tickets.text: Coordinate secure tuition funding for the $8,600 spring tuition installment at Marzipan Meadow School before the next normal advisory service cycle, ensuring funds are not routed through any unverified destination account.
tickets.evidence: Marzipan Meadow School’s payment schedule requires the next tuition installment before the next normal advisory service cycle, and Lena does not want funds routed through any unverified destination account; the agreed follow-up is to coordinate secure tuition funding by April 16, 2025.
